assertions.assertion: Calls .AddSaml() on the IdentityServer builder chain
assertions.rationale: The response calls .AddSamlPlugin() not .AddSaml(). These are different method names.

assertions.assertion: No separate NuGet package is added — SAML is built into Duende.IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: The response explicitly instructs adding a separate 'Duende.IdentityServer.Saml' NuGet package reference, contradicting this assertion.

assertions.assertion: A SamlServiceProvider is created with EntityId set to 'https://crm.contoso.com'
assertions.rationale: The response creates a 'ServiceProvider' (not 'SamlServiceProvider') with EntityId = "https://crm.contoso.com". The type name does not match.

assertions.assertion: AssertionConsumerServiceUrls uses IndexedEndpoint with Location 'https://crm.contoso.com/saml/acs' and Binding = SamlBinding.HttpPost
assertions.rationale: The response uses 'new Service(SamlConstants.BindingTypes.HttpPost, ...)' inside an 'AssertionConsumerServices' collection, not 'AssertionConsumerServiceUrls' with 'IndexedEndpoint' and 'SamlBinding.HttpPost'.

assertions.assertion: AllowedScopes is configured on the SamlServiceProvider (not empty)
assertions.rationale: No AllowedScopes property is configured anywhere on the ServiceProvider in the response.
